source: Open Food Facts selected nutrition images and AWS Google Cloud Vision OCR artifacts
limitations: This evaluates the production parser against reference OCR text, not on-device ML Kit or Apple Vision latency/accuracy.
The Android ML Kit and iOS Apple Vision bridges now exist and autolink; Android compilation passed, while an iOS device build cannot be verified from Windows.
Reference OCR uses word bounding boxes from the provider artifact and remains a parser benchmark rather than device evidence.
Full row-level reports remain local under outputs and contain no downloaded image binaries.
